public_rationale: ChatGPT experienced a substantial malfunction on February 20–21, 2024, producing nonsensical responses [e1, e2]. On February 21, before the February 29 post, OpenAI publicly explained that inference errors in certain GPU configurations caused incorrect token selection [e2]. That explanation contradicts the claim that the principal cause remained mostly unexplained [e2].
limitations: The public explanation does not disclose every implementation detail [e2].
Initial uncertainty reported on February 21 does not establish that the cause remained unexplained through February 29 [e1, e2].
The tentative six-hour duration is unscored under the contract.

statement.excerpt: ChatGPT has a mostly unexplained 6 hour (?) meltdown
statement.document_title: The last two weeks at OpenAI

our_interpretation: Meltdown means a substantial episode of abnormal, incoherent responses, not necessarily complete service unavailability.
Mostly unexplained means the principal cause remained publicly unexplained when the post appeared.
A concrete public account of the main failure mechanism can explain the incident without disclosing source code or every operational detail.
The question mark expressly makes six hours tentative. Duration is left unscored and cannot count against the claim.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish a substantial malfunction during the preceding fortnight, with its principal cause still publicly unexplained by February 29.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records show no such malfunction, or a substantive public explanation of its principal cause was available before the post. A duration different from six hours is not contradiction.
